notes.title: Update Description
notes.content:
The previous layout was designed with reference to the old-fashioned ADV.
These have a simple UI and the text is easy to read, so I personally like the design.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45263746/e45cfb06f43eefa2fd3358ea810359875a999297.jpg[/img]
However, there were two problems with the screenshots displayed in the store.
1: When displayed compactly, the character screen is quite small and visibility is poor.
2: Since there is no change in the frame and UI, the image tends to look monotonous.

For these reasons, I have changed the layout to the following:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45263746/ee65e6130622d312dc234a75ef53ad0d6d2d1482.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update 2025/02/10
